Class SuggestionServlet

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.GenericServlet
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
com.qm.bupt.servlet.BaseServlet
com.qm.bupt.servlet.SuggestionServlet
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable
@WebServlet("/suggestion") public class SuggestionServlet extends BaseServlet
Servlet generating AI-powered career suggestions for TAs.

Mapped to /suggestion?action=generateForTA. Uses the SuggestionService to produce personalized advice based on recommended job matches.
